problem_understanding: Remove interval lengths from the total number of positions.

steps.claim: For each interval, subtract right - left + 1 from L + 1.
steps.justification: This counts how many positions the interval removes.

steps.claim: Summing removed lengths gives the total number of removed positions.
steps.justification: Every interval contributes its own length.

algorithm: Subtract every interval length independently from L + 1.
correctness_argument: This fails when intervals overlap because removed positions can be subtracted more than once.
